records.passage_span: 1 Samuel 1:22–28 and 2:1ff in fragments 2a-d; offering phrase in line 7
records.notes: Published support remains limited to surviving material, not the supplied opening. DJD XVII pp. 31–35 were visually consulted; p. 32 connects column II fragments a,c-d to PAM 43.122 and inventories 998/1107. IAA B-277400 supplies that historical photograph. Acquired viewer tiles are retained only as a private study copy outside the repository. Partial context-informed inspection is recorded separately; complete image verification and source selection remain pending.
records.image_plate_id: IAA B-277400; PAM M43.122; museum inventories 998 and 1107

image_inspection.locator: Upper-right column of PAM M43.122; DJD XVII column II fragment a, line 7; Qumran-Digital fragments 2a-d line 7. The offering line crosses adjacent viewer tiles x2-y1-z3 and x3-y1-z3. These are image tiles, not glyph-coordinate annotations.
image_inspection.assessment: The historical infrared image is consistent with the published age-related word and bread. Several preceding lines match the column transcription, supporting passage alignment. This is a primed single-editor check, not a blind new decipherment, a full paleographic audit, or a restoration of the missing beginning or erased traces. The full master and a modern color/infrared cross-check remain pending.

records.notes: The transcription reads ]א֯רבע[ א]מות וזרת. The dotted alef is uncertain, but resh-bet-ayin are preserved and the numeral is contextually distinct. Most surrounding text and part of 'cubits' are editorially supplied; this record supports the numeral four, not a claim that the whole line is visible. DJD XVII pp.78–80 were directly consulted on2026-09-06; a provisional critical-source replacement was subsequently reviewed and applied, recorded in applications/goliath17_4_source_application.v1.json. The next_gate image-verification remains an unfinished image-workflow task, not a prerequisite for this published-reading application. No acquired-pixel or measured-region status changes.

records.notes: Most of the long prayer, including Urim and Thummim, is supplied. The published small unbracketed sequence cannot be promoted to support while the fragment's identification is disputed. The 2026-09-07 follow-up read extracted text of the 2024 article's section 5, pp. 36–41 and footnotes; figures 40–44 and article-cited IAA B-359488/PAM 43.072 (B-284874) remain uninspected. See docs/SAMUEL_SOURCE_COMPARISON_PASS_2.md. The 2017 dissertation is an earlier assessment. Coverage-only preserves the index candidate, not verified passage survival.
